about: No 50-state candidate-filing research table was present when this file was built. The seven examples below are carried only where the assignment supplied them; all other terms come from bounded estimates and must not be described as sourced law. Interim fallback bounds are $10-$500 in fees and 10-1,200 signatures depending on office family; point estimates below are inside those bounds. Filing dates are placeholders from January 1 through June 1, 2026. Replace estimates with researched rows as evidence arrives.

STATEWIDE.estimatedFrom: Bounded interim planning fallback: fee $100 and 250 signatures; no same-family state research was available. This is not a sourced rule.

CONGRESSIONAL.estimatedFrom: Bounded interim planning fallback: fee $100 and 250 signatures; no same-family place research was available. This is not a sourced rule.

STATE_LEGISLATIVE.estimatedFrom: Bounded interim planning fallback: fee $50 and 100 signatures; no same-family state research was available. This is not a sourced rule.

LOCAL_COUNCIL.estimatedFrom: Interim estimate centered on the assignment's disclosed municipal examples (numeric signature median 100; fee median $87.50 rounded to $88). The sample spans unlike local rules and is not a researched median for this place.
